annotations.text:
Motivation: instrument-panel precision — matches "sharp, confident" without feeling corporate.
Tradeoff: amber + warm neutrals can read slightly vintage/industrial rather than modern-app.

Motivation: dark mode stands apart from typical productivity tools; serif adds gravitas and trust.
Tradeoff: dark-only default may feel heavy for long CV-editing sessions; serif needs care at small sizes.

Motivation: familiar, fast-to-build "modern SaaS" cobalt-on-white — instantly legible and trustworthy.
Tradeoff: closest to generic — leans on the arrow motif and condensed type to avoid looking like every other blue app.
